# Shader reference

<!-- Generated by ShaderReferenceDocTest. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Common parameters

Presets usually set these too; the fallback column is used when a preset leaves one out.

| Key | Type | Fallback |
|---|---|---|
| `speed` | number 0 to 10 | `0` |
| `frame` | number 0 to 100000 (step 1) | `0` |
| `fit` | `"none"`, `"contain"`, `"cover"` | `"contain"` |
| `scale` | number 0.01 to 4 | `1` |
| `rotation` | number 0 to 360 | `0` |
| `offsetX` | number -1 to 1 | `0` |
| `offsetY` | number -1 to 1 | `0` |
| `originX` | number 0 to 1 | `0.5` |
| `originY` | number 0 to 1 | `0.5` |
| `worldWidth` | number 0 to 2000 (step 1) | `0` |
| `worldHeight` | number 0 to 2000 (step 1) | `0` |

## ripple-pond

**Ripple Pond**. Original. Water you can touch: taps drop ripples, holding stirs the surface, and tilting the phone swings the light.

Interactive: Tap or hold to make ripples · tilt to move the light

| Key | Label | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `colorDeep` | Deep | color (`ArgbColor` or `Color`) |
| `colorShallow` | Shallow | color (`ArgbColor` or `Color`) |
| `colorHighlight` | Highlight | color (`ArgbColor` or `Color`) |
| `rippleSize` | Ripple size | number 0 to 1 |
| `rippleSpeed` | Ripple speed | number 0 to 1 |
| `damping` | Damping | number 0 to 1 |
| `swell` | Swell | number 0 to 1 |
| `caustics` | Caustics | number 0 to 1 |
| `glint` | Glint | number 0 to 2 |

Presets: `Lagoon`, `Night swim`, `Honey`

## gravity-goo

## dithering

**Dithering**. Animated 2-color dithering over multiple pattern sources (noise, warp, dots, waves, ripple, swirl, sphere). Great for retro, print-like, or stylized UI textures.

| Key | Label | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `colorBack` | Color back | color (`ArgbColor` or `Color`) |

| `type` | Type | `"random"`, `"2x2"`, `"4x4"`, `"8x8"` |
| `size` | Size | number 1 to 20 |

Presets: `Default`, `Warp`, `Sine Wave`, `Ripple`, `Bugs`, `Swirl`

## dot-orbit

**Dot Orbit**. Animated multi-color dots pattern with each dot orbiting around its cell center. Supports up to (4 x 10) colors, shape and motion controls. Great for playful, dynamic backgrounds and UI textures.

| Key | Label | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `colors` | Colors | 1 to 10 colors |
| `colorBack` | Color back | color (`ArgbColor` or `Color`) |
| `stepsPerColor` | Steps per color | number 1 to 4 (step 1) |
| `size` | Size | number 0 to 1 |
| `sizeRange` | Size range | number 0 to 1 |
| `spreading` | Spreading | number 0 to 1 |

Presets: `Default`, `Bubbles`, `Shine`, `Hallucinatory`

## god-rays

**God Rays**. Animated rays of light radiating from the center, blended with up to 5 colors. The rays are adjustable by size, density, brightness and center glow. Great for dramatic backgrounds, logo reveals, and VFX like energy bursts or sun shafts.

| Key | Label | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `colors` | Colors | 1 to 5 colors |
| `colorBack` | Color back | color (`ArgbColor` or `Color`) |

| `bloom` | Bloom | number 0 to 1 |

| `density` | Density | number 0 to 1 |
| `spotty` | Spotty | number 0 to 1 |
| `midSize` | Mid size | number 0 to 1 |
| `midIntensity` | Mid intensity | number 0 to 1 |

Presets: `Default`, `Warp`, `Linear`, `Ether`

## lens-distortion

**Lens Distortion**. Lens Distortion image filter separates an image into shifting color layers (recreating the chromatic aberration of a lens) and warps the image geometry itself, curving it outward or inward like barrel and pincushion distortion.

|---|---|---|

| `angle` | Angle | number 0 to 360 |

| `count` | Count | number 2 to 50 (step 1) |

| `dispersionColor` | Dispersion color | number 0 to 1 |
| `focusCenter` | Focus center | number 0 to 1 |

| `swirl` | Swirl | number -1 to 1 |
